title: Burning Steppes
body: The Burning Steppes were green country once, the northern reaches of the Redridge Mountains, until Sorcerer-Thane Thaurissan of the Dark Irons called up Ragnaros the Firelord. Mountains melted, Blackrock Mountain was born and the land burned to ash, and the sky still glows red above its rivers of lava. In the Second War the Horde made the mountain its stronghold, and at its foot Orgrim Doomhammer slew Anduin Lothar. Now the Blackrock orcs hold the steppes again, dragonkin of the black flight swarm the eastern valleys, and the Alliance watches from Morgan's Vigil.

title: Morgan's Vigil
body: On a ridge in the southeastern corner of the steppes, among the scarred ruins of an older town, a small company of the Alliance keeps watch. Morgan's Vigil is Stormwind's only foothold in this land: an inn, a smith, a gryphon master and a handful of officers under Marshal Maxwell, drawn from every Alliance people. The Blackrock clan they watch day and night is the same that crossed the mountains to raid Redridge.

title: Dreadmaul Rock
body: Dreadmaul Rock is a great crag in the east of the steppes, riddled with caves and old mines and held by the Firegut ogres, allies of the Blackrock orcs who guard the rock's rich seams and keep the clan's supply lines open. Something darker goes on in the caves. Reports of strange rituals among the ogres drew a Horde patrol here weeks ago, and no word has come back from it.

parts.body: The patrol was captured and slain, all but its leader, Sha'ni Proudtusk of Kargath, whom the ogre Krom'Grul chained to an altar for his ritual and tortured until her body gave out.

title: Flame Crest
body: Flame Crest is a rocky outcrop in the north of the steppes, reached by a crude bridge, and no kingdom rules it. Goblins and wandering scholars do business here: a goblin studies the local dragonkin, another sells exotic pets taken from the Spire, and a dwarf treasure hunter chases the lost riches of the Dark Irons. The Horde keeps a foothold too, a wind rider master and a provisioner serving its people in this hostile land.

title: Ruins of Thaurissan
body: In the heart of the steppes lie the broken streets of Thaurissan, once capital of the Dark Iron dwarves, destroyed when their sorcerer-thane called Ragnaros into the world. The Dark Irons have not given it up. Relics still lie in the ash. Touch one and a tormented voice may warn the intruder away, as visions burn into the mind: eight dwarves at a ritual, then a lone dwarf kneeling before a monolith of flame among seven corpses.

title: Blackrock Mountain
body: The northwestern sky of the steppes belongs to Blackrock Mountain, the volcano raised by Ragnaros's coming. Within it the Dark Irons rule the depths and the Blackrock clan the Spire above, and dragonkin of the black flight hold its southern slopes. At the gate of the Spire the ghost of Franclorn Forgewright, the dwarf who built it, haunts his own tomb.

title: Marshal Maxwell
body: Marshal Maxwell commands the soldiers of Morgan's Vigil, and the Vigil has paid dearly for its post. Its commanding officer, Marshal Windsor, vanished when a Blackrock raiding party fell upon him, and a great store of intelligence on the clan went with him. Maxwell means to strike back wherever he can, and he spares none of the enemy, as none of his own were spared.

parts.body: Ragged John, the drunk of Flame Crest who was with Windsor that day, swore the marshal still lived, taken by the Dark Irons into Blackrock Depths while their leader kept his hammer, Ironfoe.
